### When You Have Ungodly Leaders
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-july-20-2024.html
Passage: Judges 9:3-6
Points:
- Abimelech's rise reveals how unholy ambition exploits familial ties and pagan bribery to build power.
- Pervasive arrogance corrupts every aspect of leadership, financial stewardship, and interpersonal relationships.
- Believers must not place their hope in corrupt human leaders or attempt to solve spiritual crises apart from God.
- Even in dark, compromised seasons, God's heart is to extend mercy and bring restoration.
- True cultural and spiritual renewal begins when individuals confess personal pride and seek God's revival.
